reviewer_notes: ProductsView renders all 200 seeded products in one unpaged <table> with no sorting, no sticky header, no row count control, numbers rendered in the proportional body font, and the only narrowing is a 3-control FilterBar plus a global search query. At 200 SKUs the user scrolls a 200-row slab with the header off-screen and cannot order by On hand / Unit cost. The fix must make the set navigable (page or virtualize + sort + sticky header) and align the numeric columns; it must keep the row-click route to product-detail, the existing filters, the q query param, DataTable's slot API and the token/theme system.
